subcategory_text: Roles and responsibilities (e.g., public relations) for communicating data processing purposes, practices, and associated privacy risks are established.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-2 (Information Security Program Leadership), AT-3
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.2 (Information security roles and responsibilities)
implementation_examples: Define roles and responsibilities for communicating data-processing purposes, practices, and associated privacy risks — including spokesperson authority, regulatory liaison, and crisis communications
Embed the roles in the operating model with backup coverage
Drill the communication response for high-stakes events (regulator requests, media)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether communication roles and responsibilities are documented
Determine whether spokesperson authority is clear
Determine whether communication drills are held
